title: About DarGlobal
text: DarGlobal is a London Stock Exchange-listed international luxury real estate developer, investor and asset manager. Tagline: 'Global Capital. Enduring Places.' It creates high-quality communities, landmark destinations and lifestyle-driven assets across premier global markets including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Spain and London. Segments span premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment and exclusive golf communities. Key figures (as of Q3 2026, indicative): 32-year track record, $23 billion gross development value (GDV), 7 international markets, and 12+ global brand partners. DarGlobal owns, invests, develops and operates high-end real estate aimed at long-term value, recurring rental income, capital appreciation and geographic diversification for global investors.

title: DarGlobal business segments
text: DarGlobal operates across several business lines: (1) Development of architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets; (2) Building luxury communities and masterplanned environments; (3) Hospitality & Leisure assets operated with world-class global brands; (4) Private Membership clubs, including an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia; (5) Golf, with globally recognised courses anchoring premium developments; (6) Commercial assets generating recurring income; (7) Asset Management via Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), investing across equity, debt and hybrid instruments in GCC, European and US gateway markets; (8) Tokenization and digital ownership structures to improve liquidity and broaden investor access to luxury real estate.

title: DarGlobal brand partners and collaborations
text: DarGlobal develops co-branded luxury properties with iconic names from automotive, fashion and hospitality. Brand partners include: The Trump Organization (Trump branded residences and hotels), Aston Martin (The Astera), Automobili Lamborghini (Tierra Viva and Painite Villas in Spain), Pagani (Da Vinci Tower and The Pagani Penthouse), Fendi Casa (Azure Oceanfront Villas and DarGlobal Mansions), Missoni (Urban Oasis and Marea), Elie Saab (Les Vagues), Mouawad (Neptune), Marriott and W Hotels (W Residences, Marriott Residences), Paramount, and Nickelodeon (Nickelodeon Hotels & Resorts at AIDA, Oman).

title: DarGlobal contact and enquiries
text: To register interest or enquire about DarGlobal projects, prospective buyers can call +1 212 715 1067 or chat on WhatsApp at +971 80040409. The website has a 'Register Your Interest' form where you provide full name, phone, email and the project of interest. DarGlobal's careers/HR contact used for recruitment is careers@darglobal.co.uk.

title: DarGlobal projects in Dubai, UAE
text: DarGlobal projects in Dubai, United Arab Emirates include: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai; D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates; DG1; Da Vinci Tower (Interiors by Pagani); Urban Oasis by Missoni; W Residences; and The Pagani Penthouse. These are branded luxury apartments, towers and villas in Dubai.

title: DarGlobal projects on Al Marjan Island, RAK, UAE
text: On Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah (RAK), UAE, DarGlobal is developing The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, a branded beachfront residence, along with Top of the Astera (sky villas).

title: DarGlobal projects in Spain
text: In Spain, DarGlobal's luxury villa projects are concentrated on the Costa del Sol: Tierra Viva and Painite Villas, both in Benahavis with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini; and Marea, Interiors by Missoni, in Casares/Cortesin. These are ultra-luxury villas aimed at buyers seeking to buy luxury villas in Spain.

title: DarGlobal projects in Qatar
text: In Qatar, DarGlobal projects include: Les Vagues by Elie Saab in Doha; Lumaia in Doha; and Trump International Simaisma, Qatar, a golf-anchored development in Simaisma. Sales for the Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma opened in October 2026 with strong demand.

title: DarGlobal AIDA masterplan and projects in Oman
text: AIDA, near Muscat, Oman, is one of the world's largest premium mixed-use developments and a DarGlobal masterplan. AIDA and wider Oman projects include: Trump International Hotel, Oman; Trump Cliff Villas; Trump Golf Villas; Fairway Villas; Azure Oceanfront Villas (Interiors by Fendi Casa); Amour Sans Detour and Amour Sans Detour 2; The Great Escape and The Great Escape 2; Coastal Investment Villas; Sunrise Haven luxury villas; Marriott Residences Aida; and Nickelodeon Hotels & Resorts at AIDA.

title: DarGlobal projects in London, UK
text: In London, United Kingdom, DarGlobal's projects are: The Mulliner at 149 Old Park Lane, and 7&8 Albert Hall Mansions overlooking Hyde Park. These are prime central London luxury residences.

title: DarGlobal projects in Saudi Arabia
text: In Saudi Arabia, DarGlobal projects span Jeddah and Riyadh. In Jeddah (Amaya district): Trump Park Residences, Trump Executive Residences (premium furnished), Amaya luxury plots, Padel Living Residences, and Trump Tower Jeddah. In Riyadh / Wadi Safar: Neptune (Interiors by Mouawad), Trump Mansions (Trump branded residences at Rayana, Wadi Safar), and DarGlobal Mansions Interiors by Fendi Casa (Wadi Safar). In November 2026 DarGlobal announced a new mixed-use development in Jeddah valued at around SAR 1 billion.

title: Recent DarGlobal news (2026)
text: Recent DarGlobal newsroom highlights: Nov 16, 2026 - Dar Global expands Saudi Arabia portfolio with a new Jeddah development valued at SAR 1 billion. Oct 26, 2026 - Dar Global Capital Partners targets high-value real estate opportunities in Dubai. Oct 7, 2026 - Dar Global opened sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar, with strong interest. title: About Wasalt
text: Wasalt is Saudi Arabia's AI-backed real estate platform for verified properties and trusted brokers. It is a Saudi-based platform that helps users buy, rent, sell, invest in and auction property across the Kingdom. Wasalt is licensed by the Real Estate General Authority (REGA) with license number 1200016591, and holds a Ministry of Tourism license (73106008), CR number 7017195509. It was founded in 2020 and is backed by Quara Holding. Wasalt brings properties, market insights and property experts together in one place.

title: Wasalt services
text: Wasalt offers these core services: Buy, Rent, Projects (verified new developments and masterplans), Daily Rentals, and Barter (a newer feature to exchange properties). It also runs online Auctions across Saudi Arabia (via Infath - the Entrustment and Liquidation Center - and private auctions, covering real estate, vehicles and movable assets), and a Matchmaker service that connects property seekers with relevant property experts. Users can also filter for commercial properties only.

title: Wasalt property types and cities
text: Wasalt lists villas, apartments, lands and commercial properties for sale and for rent. Main cities covered include Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah and Dammam. Example popular Riyadh districts for villas: Al Rimal, Al Olaya, Al Yasmeen, Al Khaleej; and for apartment rentals: Al Rimal, Al Khaleej, Al Olaya, Al Nakheel. Installment payment plans are available on some listings.

title: How to list a property on Wasalt
text: To list a property on Wasalt: create an account, enter the property details, upload photos and set the price. This is done primarily through the Wasalt App, the Wasalt Business App, or the website. To log in, tap the profile icon (top left on web, or the burger menu in the app), enter your mobile number and complete OTP verification. Daily-rental hosts can register to earn weekly, with free coverage and competitive commission rates.

title: Wasalt Auctions
text: Wasalt Auctions sells real estate assets through timed auctions where bidders compete to set the final sale price. Auctions include assets from private sellers and those in collaboration with Infath (the Entrustment and Liquidation Center). Participants can bid on real estate, vehicles and other movable assets across Saudi Arabia.

title: Wasalt Matchmaker
text: Matchmaker helps agents find potential leads based on their live listings. It matches leads using the property type, purpose, district and category of the live property. Once a listing is live, Matchmaker shows leads matching those preferences, making it easier to connect with the right buyers or renters. For seekers, it connects them with relevant property experts based on their requirements.

title: Wasalt and Christie's International Real Estate
text: Christie's International Real Estate launched in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in partnership with Wasalt, a leading real estate and technology firm. Through this partnership (CIRE Saudi), Wasalt users can explore international luxury properties with global access, exclusive listings and premium living. Wasalt provides AI-driven property search, client-agent matchmaking and auction services on a single platform.
